items.h: Makes five kicks in loss
items.s: Little made his sole field-goal attempt and all four of his PATs in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans on Sunday in London. Little made a 60-yard field goal with 1:55 left in the fourth quarter to tie the game 31-31. The Jaguars' kicker continues to deliver in big moments for the team whenever called upon. Little moves to 10-for-12 on field-goal attempts and 16-for-17 on PATs through six games in 2026.

items.h: Cam Little perfect in Week 6 loss
items.s: Cam Little connected on his lone field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-31 loss to Houston. Little connected on a 60-yard field goal for his lone make of the day. Little has missed just one kick this season and continues to show that he has one of the strongest legs in the game. Little and the Jaguars will head to their bye in Week 7.

items.h: Makes game-winning FG
items.s: Little made both of his field goals and went 1-for-2 on extra-point tries during the Jaguars' 19-17 win over the Eagles on Sunday in London. The Jaguars looked dead in the water after Eagles' kicker Jake Elliott connected on a 48-yard field goal to give Philadelphia a 17-16 lead with only eight seconds left in the fourth quarter. However, Ameer Abdullah gave Jacksonville hope with a 53-yard return on the ensuing kickoff, and Little answered the call with a 57-yard field goal to seal the victory for the Jaguars. Little is 9-for-11 on field-goal attempts through five regular-season games, with both of those misses coming from 50-plus yards. The Jaguars will stay in London for Week 6 to face…

items.h: Cam Little nails long game-winner in Week 5
items.s: Cam Little made both of his field-goal attempts and 1-of-2 PATs in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles. After missing a PAT that could have put the Jaguars up by three late in the fourth quarter, Little got a chance to make up for it with just one tick of the clock remaining during a wild finish Sunday. Little made good on the opportunity, drilling a 57-yard attempt as time expired to give the Jaguars a victory. That is Little's longest make of the season through five weeks, and he's now 9-of-11 overall on field goals for the campaign. He's one of the top kickers in the league.

items.h: Cam Little a Great Starting Option in London Face-off
items.s: Jacksonville Jaguars kicker Cam Little remains a solid fantasy starter heading into Week 5 against the Philadelphia Eagles. Little may have plenty of chances to show off his big leg to London fans, given the Eagles' defense hasn't been as good as in recent seasons. With injuries on offense as well, the Eagles will likely struggle to move the ball, giving Jacksonville more drives with good field position. Little came into the year with high fantasy expectations, and while he hasn't quite been top tier, those expectations should remain. He has missed two 50+ yard field goals, but a potent offense has given him plenty of opportunities, and both the Jaguars and fantasy managers should still…

items.h: Cam Little scores ten points in win Sunday
items.s: Cam Little went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals. Little made all four of his kicks on Sunday, including one from 55 yards out, which left him with a nice fantasy total in this win over the Bengals. Fantasy managers should continue to view him as a good option at the kicker position moving forward.

items.h: Converts three FGs in win
items.s: Little went 3-for-3 on field-goal tries and made his only PAT during Sunday's 22-17 win over the Bengals. Little delivered a pair of field-goal makes from 55 and 28 yards in the first half before later adding another 54-yard make in the third quarter. The kicker has now gone 7-for-9 on field-goal tries, including 4-for-6 from 50-plus yards, and he figures to continue to get plenty of opportunities while finishing off the drives of Jacksonville's potent offense.

items.h: Cam Little totals five points in win Sunday
items.s: Cam Little made all five of his extra-point attempts and missed his lone field-goal attempt from 70 yards out in Sunday's 35-6 win over the New England Patriots. Little ended up with just five points on Sunday, which is a little disappointing considering how easily scoring came to the Jaguars against New England. He also barely missed one kick from what would have been an NFL record 70-yards out, which further hurt his fantasy total in this matchup. He should bounce back in the near future.

items.h: Misses from 70
items.s: Little hit all five of his extra-point attempts but missed a 70-yard field-goal try in Sunday's 35-6 win over the Patriots. The Jaguars lined up for what would have been a record-setting field goal just before halftime, but Little missed it wide right. The kicker has only failed to connect on two attempts this season, a 54-yard field-goal try and this 70-yard attempt. The Jaguars have been offering him plenty of scoring opportunities through three games, and it's clear that the team doesn't hesitate to test Little's strong leg either.

items.h: Cam Little Remains Reliable Kicking Option in Week 3
items.s: Jacksonville Jaguars kicker Cam Little remains a top fantasy kicking option entering Week 3 against the New England Patriots. He did miss a 54-yard field goal last week against the Denver Broncos, but has otherwise been reliable. The Jaguars offense remains potent enough to support a good fantasy kicker, and Little still has the leg to make long field goals. He may not be quite at the level of being a contender for top kicker in fantasy at the current moment, but he is still an easy start for fantasy managers. His stats would look a lot better if he made his 54-yard attempt, which is promising for his upside going forward. In a matchup with the Patriots. Little could be in line for more…

items.h: Little went 2-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his lone PAT in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Broncos.
items.s: With the scored tied 13-13 early in the fourth quarter, Little lined up for a 54-yard field goal but pulled it wide left for his first miss of the season. His makes were from 44 and 23 yards earlier in the contest. Through two games, Little has made four of five field-goal tries and all five PATs. He'll get a date with the Patriots next Sunday.

items.h: Little went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made all four of his PATs in Sunday's 34-10 win over the Browns.
items.s: After finishing as fantasy's K5 overall last regular season, Little picked up right where he left off in Week 1 against Cleveland. His field-goal makes came from 47 and 40 yards Sunday, and he's now 31-for-37 on field goals from 40-plus yards out across 35 career regular-season contests. The big-legged Little is an every-week K1 in this Jacksonville offense.

items.h: Little made his only field-goal attempt, from 61 yards out, and did not attempt any extra points in the Jaguars' 19-0 preseason win over the Buccaneers on Friday.
items.s: Little's long-distance boot, which came with just over 10 minutes remaining in the second quarter, was undeniably impressive but not out of the norm for the third-year star. He went 13-for-16 on kicks from 50 yards and longer over 34 regular-season games in his first two campaigns, and he wraps up preseason having gone 7-for-7 on field-goal attempts while also knocking home his only PAT.

items.h: Little made all three of his field-goal attempts and his lone extra-point try in Saturday's 24-20 preseason win against the Saints.
items.s: Little showed no rust in his first game action since last season, making field goals from 54, 32 and 36 yards out, respectively. The big-legged kicker enters his third NFL campaign on the heels of a standout sophomore season during which he made 30 of 34 FG tries over 17 regular-season games and set an NFL record with a 68-yard make against the Raiders in Week 9. Little's accuracy and ability to convert from distance make him among the top kicker choices in most fantasy formats.

items.h: Little is set to reprise his role as Jacksonville's primary kicker during the upcoming season and will look to further cement his place as one of the NFL's top players at his position, Casandra Chesser of Jaguars Wire…
items.s: Little made history last year when he kicked the longest field goal in league history -- a 68-yarder in Week 9. For good measure, he booted a 67-yarder in Week 18 and outdid both of those kicks in the preseason with a 70-yarder. Overall, Little made 30 of 34 FG attempts and 50 of 51 extra-point tries, leaving little margin for him to improve. Still, he had a rough patch between Weeks 3 and 7 when he went just 4-for-8 on field-goal tries, so a reasonable goal could be to avoid any similar uneven stretches in 2026. Regardless, Little will enter the campaign as one of fantasy's most desirable…

items.h: Little made both of his two field-goal tries and converted all five of his extra-point attempts during Sunday's 41-7 win versus the Titans.
items.s: Little extended his streak of games without missing a kick to 10, and he created a very memorable moment in an otherwise very forgettable contest by booting a 67-yard field goal through the uprights that looked like it would have been good from 70. It was the second-longest made field goal in NFL history behind only Little's 68-yard missile against the Raiders in Week 9. He has earned a reputation as one of the best kickers in football going into the wild-card round when Jacksonville hosts the Bills.

items.h: Little made all three of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point tries in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Colts.
items.s: Little's field goals came from 34, 42 and 53 yards out, and they also turned a three-point Jacksonville deficit into a six-point win. The 2024 sixth-round pick has been solid for the Jags in his second season, making 87 percent of his field goals (28-of-32) and 45 of 46 extra points. He has not missed a kick from inside 40 yards.

items.h: Little made both of his field-goal attempts and all four of his extra-point tries in Sunday's 34-20 win over the Broncos.
items.s: Little remains perfect since the Jaguars' Week 8 bye, going 15-for-15 on field goals and 29-for-29 on PATs over the last eight games. Little's makes against the Broncos came from 47 and 26 yards. In a high-scoring Jacksonville offense, Little is a premier fantasy kicker headed into next Sunday's Week 17 date with the Colts.

items.h: Little made both of his field-goal attempts and went 6-for-6 on extra-point tries during the Jaguars' 48-20 win over the Jets on Sunday.
items.s: Little saw the field mostly on point-after tries and kickoffs as the Jaguars offense put on a dominant showing Sunday, but he did connect on short field goals from 33 and 22 yards in the second and third quarter, respectively. It's the eighth time this season that Little has connected on two or more field goals, five of which have come in the seven games since the Jaguars' Week 8 bye. Since the bye, the second-year kicker has made all 13 of his field-goal attempts and each of his 25 point-after tries.

items.h: Little connected on both field-goal tries and all four extra-point attempts in Sunday's 36-19 win over the Colts.
items.s: Little's field goals came from 35 and 48 yards, respectively. The kicker has not missed since Week 7, a streak that coincides with his team's 5-1 stretch over the last six games. During that run, Little has made multiple field goals in four games and at least two extra points in every game.

items.h: Little made his lone field-goal attempt and both extra-point tries in Sunday's 25-3 win over the Titans.
items.s: Little's field goal was from 45 yards. On the season, Little has made 19 of 23 field-goal attempts and 29 of 30 point-after tries through 12 contests. Since the start of November, Little has made all nine of his field goals and 15 of 15 PATs across five contests.

items.h: Little made both of his field-goal attempts and all three of his extra-point tries during the Jaguars' 27-24 overtime win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
items.s: Both of Little's made field goals came from 52 yards, the second of which took place in overtime in what ended up being the game-winning kick. The second-year kicker has shown off his range this season and is now 5-for-7 on field goals from 50-plus yards. In the four games since the Jaguars' Week 8 bye, Little has made all eight of his field-goal attempts (four of which have come from 50-plus yards) and has gone 13-for-13 on extra-point tries.

items.h: Little did not attempt a field goal and went 5-for-5 on PATs in Sunday's 35-6 win over the Chargers.
items.s: Little was held without a field-goal try for the first time this year, but his five extra-point makes were a new season high for the kicker. Little has now gone 16-for-20 on field-goal attempts, including 3-for-5 from 50-plus yards, while making 24 of 25 PATs over 10 games.

items.h: Little made all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during the Jaguars' 36-29 loss to the Texans on Sunday.
items.s: Little opened the scoring with a 32-yard chip shot in the first quarter before connecting on field goals from 53 and 33 yards in the second and third quarters, respectively. The second-year kicker has been perfect in the two games since the Week 8 bye, and for the year he is 16-for-20 on field-goal attempts and 19-for-20 on extra-point tries through nine regular-season games.

items.h: Little made all three of his field-goal attempts and each of his three point-after tries during the Jaguars' 30-29 overtime win over the Raiders on Sunday.
items.s: It was a nice bounce-back performance for Little, who had missed three of his last four kicks entering Week 9. He put the Jaguars on the board as time expired in the first half with a 68-yard field goal, and in doing so broke the NFL record for the longest made field goal, which was previously held by Justin Tucker (66 yards). It wasn't even Little's longest make of his NFL career, as he connected on a 70-yard field goal during the Jaguars' first preseason contest. The second-year kicker is now 13-for-17 on field-goal attempts and 17-for-18 on extra-point tries through eight regular-season…

items.h: Little missed his lone field-goal attempt and was successful on his only PAT during Sunday's 35-7 loss to the Rams.
items.s: After missing a field goal and an extra point last week versus Seattle, Little again failed to convert a 50-yard field goal Sunday in London. The 2024 sixth-round pick missed just two kicks as a rookie last year but has struggled to find his footing in 2025, going 10-for-14 on field goals through seven games.

items.h: Little missed a field goal and PAT during Sunday's 20-12 loss to the Seahawks.
items.s: The 2024 sixth-round pick failed to convert the PAT on Jacksonville's first touchdown of the day and also pushed a 50-yard field goal wide right late in the second quarter. After missing just two field goals and no extra points as a rookie last season, Little has gone 10-for-13 on field goals and 13-for-14 on PATs through six games in 2025.

items.h: Little made his only field-goal attempt and went 4-for-4 on extra-point tries in Monday's 31-28 win over the Chiefs.
items.s: Little made the most of his only field-goal try, connecting on a 52-yarder in the fourth quarter. The kicker has now gone 10-for-12 on field-goal attempts, including 2-for-2 from 50-plus yards, while making all 13 of his PATs over five games this year.

items.h: Little made two of three field goals and both extra-point attempts in Sunday's 26-21 win over the 49ers.
items.s: The kicker missed a 47-yard attempt late in the fourth, his second miss in as many weeks. Little did make field goals from 26 and 44 yards. For the year, he's now nine of 11 on field goals and nine of nine on extra points.

items.h: Little went 1-for-2 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs in Sunday's 17-10 win over the Texans.
items.s: Little made a 39-yard field goal to cap off the Jaguars' first possession of the second half before missing a 47-yarder wide right later in the third quarter. The missed kick was his first of the year, and he has now gone 7-for-8 on field-goat attempts, while making all seven of his extra-point tries this season.

items.h: Little made both of his field-goal attempts and all three of his extra-point tries in Jacksonville's loss to Cincinnati on Sunday.
items.s: Little made a 42-yard field goal in the second quarter to give the Jaguars a 17-10 lead at halftime, and he later converted a 25-yard attempt in the fourth quarter to put the team up 27-24 with 11:43 to play. Jacksonville held the lead much of the rest of the way before Jake Browning scored a one-yard rushing touchdown with 18 second left in regulation to give Cincinnati the win. On the season, Little has been perfect, making all six of his field-goal tries and all five of his extra points.

items.h: Little made all four of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during the Jaguars' 26-10 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
items.s: Little was responsible for 14 of the Jaguars' 26 points Sunday, with his 47-yard field goal at the end of the first half being his only kick attempt beyond 40 yards. The 2024 sixth-rounder was one of the most accurate kickers during his rookie season, when he connected on 27 of 29 field-goal attempts while making all 27 of his extra-point tries. Little's floor could receive a significant boost this season if the Jaguars' offense shows improvement under first-year head coach Liam Coen.

items.h: Little converted both of his field-goal attempts in Saturday's 14-6 preseason loss to the Dolphins.
items.s: Little accounted for all of Jacksonville's scoring, nailing kicks from 59 and 43 yards away. He also made a 70-yard field goal in Jacksonville's first preseason contest, so he appears more than ready to handle kicking duties in Jacksonville's regular-season opener against the Panthers. Little is coming off an impressive rookie campaign, as he converted 27 of his 29 field goals, including 13 of 15 from 40 yards or more.

items.h: Little made all three of his field-goal attempts and both PATs during Sunday's 26-23 loss to the Colts.
items.s: The rookie kicker converted twice from 53 yards as he put the finishing touches on an impressive debut season. Little, who was selected during the sixth round of the 2024 NFL Draft last April, went 27-for-29 on field goals and was perfect on 27 PATs this season. He should enter training camp with some decent job security given his performance as a rookie.

items.h: Little made both of his two field-goal tries and converted both of his two extra-point attempts during Sunday's 20-13 win versus the Titans.
items.s: Little opened the scoring in Week 17 with a 48-yarder to cap the first drive of the game, and he remained steady afterwards. He's now gone four straight games without missing a kick, but the Jaguars' below-average offense will likely cap his opportunities in Week 18 at Indianapolis.

items.h: Little converted both of his extra-point attempts during the Jaguars' 19-14 loss to the Raiders this past Sunday.
items.s: Coming off a 4-for-4 performance on field-goal tries against the Jets in Week 15, Little did not attempt a field goal during this past Sunday's loss. Little has been one of the most accurate kickers in the league, converting on all 23 of his extra-point attempts and going 22-for-24 on field-goal tries. He should have more opportunities to score points Sunday against a Titans team that gave up 38 points to the Colts in Week 16.

items.h: Little went 4-for-4 on field-goal tries while making his only extra-point attempt in Sunday's 32-25 loss to the Jets.
items.s: Little connected on a pair of chip-shot field goals from 28 yards and 23 yards in the first half before later adding a pair of 43-yarders in the second half. The four field-goal makes marked a new career high for the rookie and he's now gone 22-for-24 on field goals this season while hitting all 21 his extra-point tries.

items.h: Little converted his lone field-goal attempt and extra-point try in Sunday's 10-6 win over the Titans.
items.s: Little connected from 23 yards out early in the fourth quarter to get Jacksonville on the scoreboard, and he later made his only PAT attempt after a Tank Bigsby touchdown run. The rookie kicker hasn't had many opportunities this season but has converted 18-20 FGAs overall.

items.h: Little made two of his three field-goal tries during Sunday's 23-20 loss versus the Texans.
items.s: Little did not get to kick any extra-point attempts in Week 13, as Jacksonville's first touchdown of the day in the fourth quarter only cut Houston's lead to 23-12. His miss came from 55 yards out earlier in the fourth quarter, and both of his made field goals Sunday were short kicks. He doesn't profile as a great fantasy option heading into a Week 14 matchup at Tennessee.

items.h: Little made both of his field-goal attempts during Sunday's 52-6 loss to the Lions.
items.s: The 21-year-old started the scoring with a 59-yard field goal during the first quarter and added a 35-yarder to close out the first half, and that was it for Jacksonville's scoring as the offense mustered just 10 first downs. Little is 15-for-16 on field goals and 19-for-19 on extra points this season, but the Jaguars' already inconsistent offense has taken a further step back the past two weeks in the absence of Trevor Lawrence (shoulder).

items.h: Little did not record any field-goal tries but made his only extra-point attempt during Sunday's 12-7 loss versus the Vikings.
items.s: For the second straight week, Little was held without a field-goal attempt in Week 10. The Jaguars' offense was already struggling with Trevor Lawrence (shoulder) under center, and things certainly didn't improve with Mac Jones at the helm Sunday. It's probably safe to leave Little on waivers in most formats for Jacksonville's game at Detroit in Week 11.

items.h: Little did not attempt a field goal and converted his lone PAT during Sunday's 28-23 loss to the Eagles.
items.s: The Jaguars had successful two-point conversions on their first two touchdowns after trailing 22-0, and Little's only opportunity came after the third touchdown late in the fourth quarter. It's the first time all season the rookie sixth-round pick didn't attempt a field goal, and he remains a volatile fantasy option due to Jacksonville's erratic offense.
